messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (1918500000) - elevated mismatch errors and write latencies observed originating from prefix-KV layer for tenant 'zen-retail'. Paging rotation.

nina_keller: Picking this up. dashboards show a surge in prefix read misses + concurrent writes causing stale-read windows. Starts right after prefetch rollout last night.

rafael_montez: Are customers seeing 5xxs or just stale data? Any requests retried?

nina_keller: Both. A subset of reads return older versions while some writes are getting transient timeouts. Error spike concentrated on region-us-east-1 GPUs (pool-7). Marking incident sev=P1 due to data correctness.

priya_shah: Proposed immediate mitigations: (A) disable aggressive prefetching globally for tenant's prefixes, (B) enable read-through-only fallback for affected prefixes, (C) apply short-lived token-based rate limit to cap write QPS for the tenant.

dina_ops: Also suggest increasing LRU eviction waterline on nodes serving the pool to avoid premature evicts during warmup.

nina_keller: Executing mitigation steps now. Commands run:
```
# turn off prefetch for tenant
POST https://controlplane/api/v1/prefetch/tenants/zen-retail/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
# enable read-through on routing layer for prefixes matching /p/zen/*
curl -X PATCH "https://gateway/config" -d '{"route":"/p/zen/*","cache":"read-through"}'
# rate limit writes
curl -X POST "https://gateway/admin/limit" -d '{"tenant":"zen-retail","scope":"write","qps":120}'' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

incident-bot: Actions applied: prefetch_disabled(tenant=zen-retail), route_patch(read-through), write_qps_limit=120. Rolling update to eviction waterline on pool nodes scheduled (rollout_id=5743).

rafael_montez: I'll flip a tiny percentage (~0.5%) of traffic to cache-bypass reads to validate correctness from origin. If those look good, ramp to 5% then 20%.

priya_shah: Implemented concurrency cap for tenant at gateway layer: concurrency=40, burst=80.

nina_keller: Observing metrics: 5xx rate down ~55% after 8 minutes, stale-read alerts dropping. Eviction events trending lower as waterline increased.

cs_manager: Notifying account team and CSM for zen-retail with a brief summary and timeline.

dina_ops: Logging mitigation record in incident tracker. Recommending we keep current mitigations for 90 minutes, then test a controlled prefetch re-enable with conservative backoff and per-prefix shielding.

incident-bot: Next oncall = rafael_montez at 1918500320. Please ack prior to handoff. Current status: mitigated_in_progress. Tags: cache, kv, traffic-mitigation, oncall.

rafael_montez: Acknowledged. I'll continue automated checks (sampled bypass correctness, tail-latency histograms) and escalate if regressions occur. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=stabilizing; mitigations=tenant_prefetch_disabled|read-through-routing|write_qps_limit|evict_waterline_bump|concurrency_cap. impact=correctness & write latency (reduced).
